If I bid more, I risk winning and paying more than my value if the second-highest bid is also above my value, which would result in a loss. Bidding my true value ensures I only win when I can make a profit or break even.

This is because bidding below my value risks losing to a bid I would have been happy to beat, and bidding above my value risks winning and paying more than the item is worth to me. Since this is the first round and there's no history, I'll stick to the dominant strategy.
